column1: # Zoo truth table: what a careful analyst would say about each published port (e2e/zoo/README.md explains the columns).
# service: nmap service name (regex). product: technology name (regex, case-insensitive). version: the version the service
# itself states to an unauthenticated GET or banner (prefix match); empty when it does not state one. techs: other
# technologies that must be named (comma-separated regexes). classes: classes that must be set. finding: a finding title
# substring that must be raised. ok: further technologies or classes that are right but not required (regexes).
# ready: http<path>, https<path> or tcp: what run.sh waits for before the scan.
